CustomField.description: Marked for deletion if Interaction Stat was created yesterday. Before 12am today and after 12am yesterday GMT
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( CreatedDate <= DATETIMEVALUE(TODAY()), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(TODAY()-1) ), TRUE, FALSE )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Will be deleted today because it was created yesterday (GMT).
CustomField.label: Delete in next scheduled flow run
